deployment.layout_candidate: Chassis-mounted in-house reduction unit, short guarded chain to a supported pivot, physical deployed/stowed stops and positive service/stow retention
deployment.reason_unselected: Current CAD mass screen leaves high peak current demand even at 64:1; mass reduction, motion duration, possible counterbalance and hardware load ratings must be resolved
deployment.impact_collapse: Not implied by a backdrivable chain/gear train; controlled torque, geometry and mechanical protection require verification

required_before_release: Actual pulley STEP/drawing and axial retention stack
Separate axial planes for the two middle-shaft pulleys
Manufacturer tooth and tensile load limits at the actual speed
Full-span guarding, misalignment and reversing duty checks
Continuous pickup contact and front floating preload/stops
Actual source period/availability versus intended competition season
